summary.tldr: Implements the Canada-Indonesia trade agreement, gives the government order-making powers, and updates related laws.
what_it_does: Approves the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement between Canada and Indonesia, signed in Ottawa on September 24, 2025.
Blocks legal action based on certain parts of the law or the agreement unless the Attorney General of Canada consents.
Requires Canada to pay its share of the costs tied to the agreement’s institutional and administrative work.
Gives the Governor in Council power to make orders under the agreement.
Amends related Acts so they match Canada’s obligations under the agreement.
summary.background: The bill implements the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement between Canada and Indonesia, done at Ottawa on September 24, 2025.
